messages:
alex: Heads-up — quick sync on telemetry emitter changes for per-route SLO panels (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Need cross-team agreement before I ship the runtime patch.
maria: 👍 what's the exact payload change you're proposing?
alex: Minimal additive fields. Example JSON for each inference completion event we'll emit from runtime:

```
{
  \"event_type\": \"inference.complete\",
  \"env\": \"prod\",        // prod/stage
  \"route_id\": \"chat-inline-v2\",
  \"model\": \"redwood-v1.3q\",
  \"model_version\": \"2026-03-10\",
  \"p50_ms\": 48,
  \"p95_ms\": 120,
  \"p99_ms\": 320,
  \"ttft_ms\": 12,
  \"tokens_out\": 64,
  \"tokens_in\": 18,
  \"tokens_per_sec\": 125.4,
  \"request_size_bytes\": 2048,
  \"sample_rate\": 0.01
}
```

alex: sample_rate will be applied at emitter time to control volume (default 1% for high-traffic routes). We want console to be able to roll up to per-route and per-model aggregations.
raj: ingest side: can accept these fields but want stable keys. Prefer `latency_p50_ms` etc to avoid confusion with other latency types. Also we need a `bucket_key` for cardinality-safe rollups (route + model + env).
jamie: agree on stable keys. +1 for `latency_p50_ms/latency_p95_ms/latency_p99_ms`. `bucket_key` sounds fine, maybe `route_model_env`.
noah: console/ux: we need the emitter to include `route_display_name` OR we'll need a mapping table in ingest. Prefer adding `route_name` (human) and `route_id` (stable key).
alex: ok will include `route_name`. Updated example:

```
{
  \"event_type\": \"inference.complete\",
  \"env\": \"prod\",
  \"route_id\": \"chat-inline-v2\",
  \"route_name\": \"chat.inline (v2)\",
  \"model\": \"redwood-v1.3q\",
  \"model_version\": \"2026-03-10\",
  \"latency_p50_ms\": 48,
  \"latency_p95_ms\": 120,
  \"latency_p99_ms\": 320,
  \"ttft_ms\": 12,
  \"tokens_out\": 64,
  \"tokens_in\": 18,
  \"tokens_per_sec\": 125.4,
  \"sample_rate\": 0.01,
  \"bucket_key\": \"chat-inline-v2|redwood-v1.3q|prod\"
}
```

maria: ingest has a throughput quota. At 1% sample for top routes that's still a lot. We need a strategy: dynamic sampling by traffic tier + upstream quotas. Can we emit a lightweight metrics event for counters (low cardinality) and sampled detailed events for histograms? That would reduce volume.
raj: we already have `metric.counter` and `metric.histogram` pipelines. Proposal: emit two events per request in heavy routes: 1) metrics counter (route/model/latency_bucket) always, 2) detailed `inference.complete` only when sampled. Ingest can derive p50/p95 from histogram counters and use detailed events for debugging/ttft/tokens/sec.
jamie: console panels should prefer aggregated histogram ingestion for SLO graphs (stable, low cardinality). Use sampled detailed events for drilldown and example traces.
noah: for rollouts UX we need a flag in payload for `rollout_group` or `canary=true` so dashboards can filter canary vs prod traffic automatically.
alex: will include `rollout_group` (string) and `is_canary` (bool). Example: `rollout_group: \"canary-512\"`, `is_canary: true`.
maria: ownership: infra (raj) to update ingest adapters to accept new keys + backward compat. Runtime (alex) to ship emitter with toggles behind feature flag. Console (noah) to adjust panels to use histograms by default and detailed events for drilldowns. Product (maria) will own SLO thresholds and alerts.
raj: timeline: I can update ingest adapters this week if emitter schema is final by EOD tomorrow. Need protobuf + JSON schema please.
alex: will open PR with proto + JSON schema today. Feature flag `runtime.emitter.v2` default off. Will add env var sampling config `EMITTER_SAMPLE_RATE_OVERIDES` keyed by route.
noah: panel UX ask: add per-route dropdown, p50/p95/p99 toggle, TTFT panel, tokens/sec trend, and a small sparklines column. Also ability to compare two models/versions side-by-side.
jamie: for rollouts we should add a small warning if sampled traffic is < 0.1% for data scarcity; console can show a badge `low-sample` with a tooltip explaining sampling.
alex: quick question on units: `tokens_per_sec` we plan to send as float tokens/sec averaged over the request. Agree?
maria: yes that's fine. Keep `tokens_per_sec` as float. Also add `tokens_total` as integer if helpful.
alex: adding `tokens_total` too.
noah: can we include request route tags for quota grouping (e.g., `quota_group`) so billing/quotas can be sliced?
raj: ingest team prefers separate `quota_group` field. Ok to add.
alex: summarizing action items:
- alex: PR emitter proto + JSON schema, include `route_name`, `bucket_key`, `latency_*`, `ttft_ms`, `tokens_total`, `tokens_per_sec`, `is_canary`, `rollout_group`, `quota_group`. Feature flag `runtime.emitter.v2`. (ETA: today EOD)
- raj: adapt ingest adapters + histogram counters mapping; decide final key names; add `bucket_key` indexing. (ETA: 3 days)
- maria: define SLO thresholds and sampling policy doc (ETA: 5 days)
- noah: console panel spec + mockups (ETA: 1 week)
- jamie: add low-sample badge behavior to console alerts (ETA: 1 week)

maria: sounds good. please add these to the inbox thread and tag owners. I'll triage infra quotas after ingest PR.
alex: will tag and create PR now. pinging @raj @noah @jamie for visibility.
deploy-bot: Scheduled job `metrics-ingest-tests` succeeded (build 7821).
noah: thanks — once PR links up I'll start drafting the dashboard JSON and wireframes.
raj: I'll review the proto tonight. If anything blocking I'll raise it in this thread.
jamie: :thumbsup:
